extra.message: Weak/hardcoded JWT secret falls back to known value — Complete authentication bypass: attacker can forge tokens for any user and gain any role, leading to full data access and system compromise. [verified: Line 16 sets SECRET_KEY to a static fallback 'dev-only-change-me-for-local-runs' if the environment variable is unset, enabling anyone to forge valid JWTs. No compensating control prevents exploitation when the env var is missing, leading to complete authentication bypass.]
